note: Yosemite National Park campground in mixed-conifer forest off Big Oak Flat Road near the Tioga Road junction, 17 miles from Yosemite Valley; rebuilt recently, with paved roads and spurs and a food locker at each site. No electricity, so no restroom lights; no cell service or public phone. The gas station and store are nearby; showers and the dump station are in the Valley. Most sites take only short rigs. Park entrance fee is extra. --Claude
summary: Crane Flat (Yosemite NPS): nps.gov campgrounds table + rec.gov 232452 (rules, rates, catalog) + Google + Esri. $36 confirmed; site count 166 -> 148 after the rebuild; only 30 sites fit a 23-ft rig (max 35). Added rolling 14-day window, 14-night max, 05-21..10-12 season, no showers/dump on site. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin moves ~650 m south onto the loops.

BOOKING: the inherited 180-day federal window is wrong here; recreation.gov's reservationWindow is 14 days and the NPS table says '2 weeks ahead', so window_opens_days is 14.
